issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` that lets an author declare the check relationship, plus an advisory structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates, tracked as post-0.1 item R025. No open bead covers implementing it. Work: extend the dependency model so `verifies` edges are accepted and cycle-checked like `blocks` (never rejected for inversion), surface the inversion diagnosis in the dependency/doctor reporting surface, document the new kind in schema/field guide and help, and add concurrency and conformance tests per the AGENTS.md rule that every mutation is atomic, auditable, and concurrency-tested. Constraints from the ADR: the diagnosis is advisory only and cannot make a bead eligible or ineligible (R021 posture), the relationship is never inferred from issue titles, and §3.4's existing two-kind behavior must not change silently for consumers.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the `verifies` dependency kind and structural inversion diagnosis (R025, ADR-001)
